test: review cost: full dispatch identity for 1000 multi-megabyte messages

input.text: unique indexed user messages, 350 repetitions of review history per message

method: Actual registered context/end/provider hooks; 10 warmups and 100 samples per repeated dispatch condition; first dispatch and end attribution are single measurements. Separately JSON-parsed equivalent bodies create fresh strings before, not inside, timing. Context timing includes fixture cloning and the handler, so it is not isolated fence cost. No HTTP, DB, JSON serialization or cloning in timed repeated hook paths. No superseded-request nonces. stringify is a separate baseline.

runs.suite: independent file, 10 pass before cache-only witness addition
restored final 14-file gate, 98 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail, 398 assertions

limitations: Two runs on the same Linux runner, not a hardware-normalized benchmark. All messages are text/user; heavily nested tool arguments or image/blob values may have different traversal/allocation costs. RSS and browser/provider elapsed time were not measured. Different JSC warmup/GC state explains substantial run-to-run variation; no submillisecond guarantee is claimed.
